title: Rescuing Points Trapped Inside Incorrect Decision Regions: A target for Evaluating and Improving Forward-Forward Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.16347v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Forward-Forward learning replaces end-to-end backpropagation with local, layer-wise training objectives. Its variants are evaluated primarily by classification accuracy, often measured with linear probes trained on their representations. We show that this evaluation can over-credit the learning method: a linear probe on the representations of an untrained convolutional neural network already reaches accuracy well above chance. Moreover, a single accuracy value does not reveal which datapoints become correctly classified after training and which remain misclassified. To examine what learning contributes beyond the random, untrained baseline, we present an analysis methodology built on the Boundary Proximity Index (BPI), a multiclass margin normalized by a class-centroid reference. We apply our analysis to seven Forward-Forward variants and related layer-local methods and find that initially misclassified points near the probe's decision

translated_title: 拯救被困在错误决策区域内的点：评估与改进前向-前向学习的一个目标
translated_abstract: 前向-前向学习用局部的、逐层的训练目标取代了端到端的反向传播。其各种变体主要通过分类准确率来评估，而准确率通常是用在所学表示上训练的线性探针来测量的。我们表明，这种评估方式可能会过度归功于学习方法本身：在一个未经训练的卷积神经网络的表示上，线性探针就已经能够达到远高于随机水平的准确率。此外，单一的准确率数值无法揭示哪些数据点在训练后变得被正确分类、哪些仍然被错误分类。为了考察学习在随机、未经训练的基线之外究竟贡献了什么，我们提出了一种基于边界接近指数（BPI）的分析方法，该指数是一种由类中心参考归一化的多类分类边际。我们将该分析应用于七种前向-前向变体以及相关的逐层局部方法，发现初始被错误分类的、靠近探针决策边界的点……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出基于边界接近指数（BPI）的分析方法，指出仅凭准确率评估前向-前向学习会高估其贡献，并发现初始被误分类点的空间位置（靠近决策边界与否）决定了训练后能否被“拯救”，从而为评估和改进逐层局部学习提供了新的目标。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces an analysis framework based on the Boundary Proximity Index (BPI), showing that accuracy-based evaluation over-credits Forward-Forward learning and that whether initially misclassified points near decision boundaries can be "rescued" offers a better target for evaluating and improving layer-local learning.
